summary: Tested the three new features on backend and UI (375x667). Privacy Officer: public GET returns the default; PUT is admin-only (401 with no login, 403 for drivers and merchants); validation works (422 for name <2 or >80 chars or missing email, 400 for a bad email); input is trimmed and lowercased. The admin form saves and the public /privacy Contact section shows the new name and email. Driver Feedback: count, avg, avg_30d, count_30d, stars, compliments, issues and recent all match the DB (seeded tagged ratings on drv-1). Response has no patient names or addresses. drv-2 gets 403, a merchant gets 403, no login gets 401, admin gets 200. The card renders on /driver/summary/drv-1. Batch savings: mer-2 shows drops=4 and CA$10.96 (4 x 2.74). Last month's batch invoices and Standard-tier invoices are excluded. mer-1 has no batch_savings field and no badge. Two minor backend bugs found. Regression run with -n 0 (privacy_compliance, rating_tags_pickup_first_pharmacy_summary, invoices_hst, tiers_pharmacy_kw, low_ratings_badges, pricing_billing, scorecard_rating_labels, rx_handoff_batch_alerts, statement_card_pay): 144/144 passed. All test data cleaned up. Privacy officer is back to the default, pricing is still 8.99/16 and mer-2 is still a pharmacy partner.

minor.issue: min_length=2 is checked on the raw name, before whitespace is collapsed. A name of only spaces ('   ') returns 200 and saves an empty name, so GET falls back to 'Privacy Officer' but keeps the custom email. A name like ' a ' saves as the 1-character 'a'. Check the length after normalising (or use a field_validator) and return 400/422.
Does not call get_driver_or_404. An admin asking for an unknown id (drv-nope) gets 200 with zero counts instead of 404.

ui_bugs.issue: dayLabel(r.rated_at.slice(0,10)) uses the UTC date. Ratings given after about 8pm Toronto time will show the next day's label.

issues: The badge text hard-codes '$6.25 INSTEAD OF $8.99'. These should come from the API (PHARMACY batch_rate/standard_rate) so the text cannot drift from the amount.
The badge also shows for a pharmacy partner with 0 batch drops this month ('CA$0.00 SAVED'). Consider hiding it or showing a hint instead.
DriverFeedbackCard returns null while loading and on error, with no error or retry state.
Legacy seeded ratings have only rating_comment and no rating_tags, so on a fresh seed TOP COMPLIMENTS / TO WORK ON stay empty until new tagged ratings arrive. Consider seeding rating_tags.

action_items: Reject a blank or too-short officer_name after trimming/collapsing whitespace in set_privacy_officer.
(Low) Convert rated_at to the America/Toronto date before calling dayLabel in DriverFeedbackCard. Take the batch and standard rates for the badge text from the API response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5452 lines; it should be split into routers.
The positive tag set is hard-coded inside driver_feedback; it should be a module constant next to RATING_TAGS.
The 'Pharmacy batch' tier string is repeated across server.py (rerate, summary, invoices). Use a constant.

success_rate.backend: 13/15 new tests passed (2 minor bugs); regression 144/144 passed
success_rate.frontend: 100% (officer form, /privacy contact, driver feedback card, mer-2 badge, mer-1 no badge)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only: TEST_ stops cloned from a drv-1 route stop with ratings and tags, and TEST_ invoices for mer-2 with tier 'Pharmacy batch'. All removed. Privacy officer settings unset, so the default is back.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seeded stop docs must include the full Stop fields (clone an existing stop), or /drivers/{id}/summary returns 500. ui_seed_iter37.py seed|clean does this and also resets the privacy officer. Mer-1 saved notes include older leftover entries (xxxx..., +14155550166 Gate 2222) from previous iterations. Run suites with -n 0 in the foreground.
